title: Music Player (Vine)
description: Music Player Mod adds a simple in-game music player to Minecraft.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35fa47daa5830e6ce63ac390566f676e0a0490c5_0.webp)
Music Player is a client mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 on Fabric
which allows you to listen to music directly in the game.

Supports:
• Local audio files (MP3, OGG, WAV, FLAC) via drag & drop
• SoundCloud (direct link to the track)

Technical requirements:
• Minecraft 1.21.11
• Fabric Loader 0.18.1+
• Fabric API 0.141.3+1.21.11
• Java 21

![Just Game Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5e26850769ae049f586e17e532297d6b563fc2e_0.webp)

Player:
- Playlist with unlimited tracks
- Play, pause, stop, next, previous
- Auto skip to next track
- Volume control (slider + mouse wheel)
- Save playlist between sessions

Interface:
- Dark color scheme with blue accent
- Track progress bar in playlist
- HUD with track name and progress bar
- HUD position selection (4 corners of the screen)
- "♪ Music Player" button in the main menu

Keys (can be changed in settings):
M — open/close player
. — play / pause
/ — next track
, — stop



Local files:
Drag and drop MP3/OGG/WAV/FLAC file into the player window.

SoundCloud:
Paste the link to the track soundcloud.com/... into the input field
and press Enter or "+ Add".

HUD position:
Press the "HUD: ..." button in the player to change the screen angle.
Automatically saved.
